6.30 rsInvalidBackgroundHatchType
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidBackgroundHatchType is a critical error that will occur when a Style.BackgroundHatchType
element is set to a constant String that is not one of its valid values.
